    if tau_filter < 0 or np.isinf(tau_filter) or np.isnan(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")

    # Compute losses (negative log-likelihood)
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margins: both differences must exceed tau
    margin1 = loss_no_call - loss_with_result
    margin2 = loss_call_only - loss_with_result
    margin = np.minimum(margin1, margin2)
